baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 names the speakers' fathers, and word 2 places them at temporal precedence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The parenting branch makes the fathers causal and formative predecessors, while firstness orders them at the head of a chain. The elliptical question therefore extends an unstated proposition backward through generations.

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood and upbringing supply the causal, formative link between the speakers and their predecessors.
Beginning and precedence place those fathers at the temporal head of the generational chain.

changed_reading.before: A fragment that merely adds the speakers' earlier fathers to an unstated question.
changed_reading.after: A scope test that reaches through the speakers' causal ancestry to the head of the generational chain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing of fathers at word 1 with the outcome-return branch available to word 2 places human origin beside eventual issue.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fathers mark the speakers' point of derivation; the return-to-outcome branch makes the same compact phrase bend from beginning toward terminus. The ancestors are not only earlier beings but beings posed with an eventual issue or return.

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood supplies human origin and formative causation.
Return to an outcome supplies a possible endpoint folded into the designation of the earliest fathers.

changed_reading.before: The fathers are distinguished only by an earlier date.
changed_reading.after: The phrase holds origin and outcome together, asking after the eventual issue of those from whom the speakers originated.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive fathers at word 1 can combine with household and uninterrupted-succession branches mapped for word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase can evoke a lineage body rather than a list of male individuals: members return to an ancestral household head and follow one another without a break. Temporal firstness thus acquires corporate continuity.

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood anchors the reading in actual descent and formative ancestry.
The household whose members return to its head supplies corporate lineage rather than isolated ancestry.
One-after-another succession supplies continuity through the generations.

changed_reading.before: The phrase points to separate ancestors located in the past.
changed_reading.after: It can point to a continuous lineage body organized by descent, household return, and succession.

context_deltas.mechanism: Companionship and enclosure first make a bounded cohort; shade then offers the image of protection, but coolness and cherished honor are negated. Against the focus's father-household complex, ancestral belonging becomes a shelter that cannot cool, protect, or confer standing.

activation_trace.role: Paternal upbringing supplies the expected protective relation that the context can invert.
Household return supplies the lineage enclosure whose protective force is tested.
Companionship and abiding association turn the addressed people into a durable cohort.
Enclosure from all sides supplies the spatial image of group containment.
Shelter and protection supply the expected function of an enclosing cover.
Cooling supplies relief, while the verse's negation removes that relief from the shelter.
Cherished value supplies social honor, while the coordinated negation removes that status.

structural_cues: 56:41-44 moves from repeated group designation to enclosing heat and shade, then explicitly negates coolness and honor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a companion cohort, enclosure, shelter, and negated relief and honor; I infer that the father-household image is being stripped of protective efficacy. Alternatively, the environmental sequence may remain wholly separate from ancestry.

changed_reading.before: The fathers are a neutral lineage category added to the question.
changed_reading.after: They can be heard as an invoked ancestral shelter whose household protection and prestige no longer avail.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prior ease is followed by determined persistence in breach. Joined to causal fatherhood and temporal firstness, that sequence turns ancestry from chronology into a possible transmission channel for a settled pattern: privilege releases conduct, persistence carries it, and breach gives it covenantal weight.

activation_trace.role: Paternal formation supplies the intergenerational channel through which a pattern could be inherited.
Temporal precedence locates the named fathers before the speakers in the proposed transmission chain.
Prior occurrence supplies an antecedent condition and reinforces the backward temporal orientation.
Expansive ease that releases its possessor supplies the social condition preceding the settled conduct.
Determined persistence hardens conduct into a continuing pattern rather than an isolated act.
Oath-breaking supplies the breach structure around which persistence coheres.

structural_cues: 56:45-46 places prior ease before continued persistence in the great breach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior ease, persistence, breach, and the focus's fathers-first sequence; I supply the arrow of intergenerational transmission. A live alternative is that only the current speakers' conduct is described and the fathers are merely additional cases.

changed_reading.before: The first fathers matter only because they are temporally remote.
changed_reading.after: They may also mark the head of a socially reproduced pattern whose persistence reaches the present speakers.

context_deltas.mechanism: Loss of life is decomposed into dust and hard bone, then answered by stirring what is still. The focus extends that material problem to the temporally earliest fathers, making them the maximal-duration and maximal-dispersal test of the same reversal.

activation_trace.role: Actual ancestors supply human bodies whose relation to the speakers is concrete rather than generic.
Temporal precedence maximizes the elapsed interval applied to those ancestral bodies.
Departure of life and power supplies the first state in the material reversal.
Earth and dust supply bodily dispersal and loss of bounded form.
Hard bone supplies the resistant bodily remainder set beside dispersive dust.
Stirring the still from rest supplies the reversal demanded of death, dust, and bone.

structural_cues: 56:48 is a coordinated interrogative fragment immediately after 56:47's death-dust-bones-raising question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the material sequence and immediate interrogative continuation; I infer that temporal firstness scales the difficulty by duration and dispersal. Alternatively, 56:48 may simply add another population without implying a harder case.

changed_reading.before: The question includes the speakers' former fathers as one more group.
changed_reading.after: The former fathers become the limiting case: bodies most remote in time and most fully dispersed must also be stirred from stillness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reply pairs the former with the later, gathers what is dispersed, and fixes that gathering to a marked appointment. This resizes the possessive 'our fathers' from a private kin subset into one segment of an exhaustive temporal totality.

activation_trace.role: The speakers' fathers supply the initially narrow kin-defined set.
Firstness supplies the temporal pole that the following reply generalizes.
The repeated former category lifts focus firstness from one family to a general temporal class.
Laterness supplies the opposite temporal pole and closes the scope around both ends.
Joining the dispersed into one whole supplies the operation applied across the temporal poles.
A fixed appointment supplies the common temporal destination of the collected generations.
Known disclosure removes indeterminacy from the appointed convergence.

structural_cues: 56:49 repeats the focus's former category opposite a later category, and 56:50 gives both one collective predicate and appointment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the former-later pairing, gathering, and fixed known appointment; I infer that 56:49-50 answers and expands the focus's possessive scope. Alternatively, the pair may be simple enumeration without pressure on the force of 'our'.

changed_reading.before: The speakers ask about their own ancestral subset.
changed_reading.after: Their ancestors are absorbed into a complete cross-generational collection whose shared appointment overrides private lineage boundaries.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory makes fatherhood include feeding and raising, while the context moves through eating, a tree-of-origin branch, filled interiors, drinking, and thirst that remains unsatisfied. Paternal nurture is thereby inverted: a lineage founded in provision culminates in compulsory intake that cannot nourish or relieve.

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood as upbringing and feeding supplies the nurture relation that the ingestion sequence reverses.
Taking food supplies the first act in the inverted provision sequence.
The tree as an origin supplies a cross-domain image of lineage source within what is consumed.
Filling to the measure of a vessel makes ingestion exhaustive rather than sustaining.
The bodily interior supplies the vessel in which the failed provision accumulates.
Taking liquid continues the provision pattern from food into drink.
Unquenchable thirst shows that abundant intake fails at nurture's basic function.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fatherhood-as-nurture, eating, a tree-of-origin branch, filling, drinking, and unrelieved thirst; I infer an inversion from ancestral provision to anti-nourishment and analogize plant origin to genealogy. Alternatively, the sequence may be only bodily punishment with no lineage resonance.

changed_reading.before: The fathers matter as biological and temporal predecessors.
changed_reading.after: They can also evoke a chain of nurture whose endpoint is grotesquely reversed into filling without nourishment and drinking without relief.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's father-household possibility meets a prepared reception for arrivals on a bounded period of accounting. The ancestral household no longer determines belonging or hospitality; the whole lineage arrives under an external host's adjudicated provision.

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood supplies descent and the expectation of household provision.
Household return supplies the corporate home whose hospitality is displaced.
Prepared provision for an arriving guest supplies an inverted reception scene.
A bounded span supplies the common occasion on which the lineage arrives.
Accounting and recompense make the reception adjudicative rather than protective.

structural_cues: 56:56 closes the unit by assigning a prepared reception on a day characterized by accounting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ancestral household, guest provision, bounded time, and accounting; I infer a reversal from family hospitality to externally adjudicated reception. Alternatively, the reception term may function only as an ironic label for provisions, without household contrast.

changed_reading.before: The fathers define the household to which the speakers belong.
changed_reading.after: The lineage itself becomes a body of arrivals whose final reception is set by accounting rather than ancestral household membership.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the form-distant و ل ي mapping of the focus's second root and treats kinship as rhetorical allegiance. It remains anchored in the possessive fathers, that mapped branch, and the saying-denial sequence. Render it only as an exploratory speech-act possibility, not as a lexical replacement for temporal firstness or a claim about the historical fathers' beliefs.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The possessive fathers at word 1 and the alternate allegiance branch mapped for word 2 can combine kinship with social support.

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood supplies the kin authority that the speakers could enlist.
Love, support, and allegiance supply a deliberately form-distant social relation around the former fathers.
Speech as belief or doctrine turns the preceding question into a position, not only an information request.
Attribution to denial frames that position as a contested speech act.

changed_reading.before: The speakers ask whether their ancestors share the same unstated outcome.
changed_reading.after: They may also be enlisting ancestral belonging as a social warrant for the position: our forebears stand with our claim.

strongest_changes: The death-dust-bone-stirring sequence makes the earliest fathers the maximal-duration case of material reversal.
The former-later pairing and fixed gathering dissolve the possessive family subset into an exhaustive temporal collection.
Prior ease followed by persistent breach recasts ancestry as a possible channel of socially reproduced conduct.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's two roots jointly carried formative causation and temporal priority, while the split mappings of the second root kept outcome, household, succession, and allegiance readings available for context to activate.
remaining_uncertainties: Because the focus is elliptical, several changes depend on assigning directional force to the immediately adjacent ayat.
Household, succession, outcome, and allegiance use branch-distant mappings and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The packet does not state that the fathers transmitted conduct, protection, or provision; those arrows are reader-supplied.
